record.original_question:
Let ψ be a function in L2(R). For integers j,k ∈ Z, define the dyadic dilates and translates
ψ_{j,k}(x) := 2^{j/2} ψ(2^j x − k). Call ψ an orthonormal wavelet if the collection {ψ_{j,k} : j,k ∈ Z} forms an orthonormal basis of L2(R).

Consider the set of all orthonormal wavelets as a subset of the unit sphere in L2(R). Is this set path connected in the L2(R) norm, meaning that for any two orthonormal wavelets ψ0 and ψ1 there exists a continuous map Ψ:[0,1]→L2(R) (continuous in the L2 norm) with Ψ(0)=ψ0, Ψ(1)=ψ1, and Ψ(t) an orthonormal wavelet for every t ∈ [0,1]?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let L^2(R) denote the Hilbert space of square-integrable complex-valued functions on the real line, equipped with its usual norm. For ψ ∈ L^2(R) and integers j, k ∈ Z, define the dyadic dilates and integer translates

  ψ_{j,k}(x) := 2^{j/2} ψ(2^j x − k),  x ∈ R.

A function ψ ∈ L^2(R) is called an orthonormal wavelet if the family {ψ_{j,k} : j, k ∈ Z} is an orthonormal basis of L^2(R). Every orthonormal wavelet has unit L^2-norm, so the set W of all orthonormal wavelets is naturally a subset of the unit sphere of L^2(R).

Question: Is W path-connected in the L^2(R) norm? That is, given any two orthonormal wavelets ψ_0, ψ_1 ∈ W, does there exist a map Ψ : [0,1] → L^2(R), continuous with respect to the L^2 norm, such that Ψ(0) = ψ_0, Ψ(1) = ψ_1, and Ψ(t) is an orthonormal wavelet for every t ∈ [0,1]?
artifact.status_search_result: The path-connectivity of the set of all orthonormal wavelets in L^2(R) is a long-standing open question (often attributed to the Wutam Consortium). Partial results are known: the MSF (minimally supported frequency) wavelets and s-elementary wavelets form path-connected subsets, and path-connectivity has been established for various subclasses such as MRA wavelets and MRA Parseval wavelets. A conjecture of Rzeszotnik asserts that orthonormal wavelets with a fixed dimension function form a path-connected set, but this remains open in full generality. No proof of (dis)connectivity for the entire set W has been published.

status_evidence.title: Open Problems in Wavelet Theory — Bownik
status_evidence.snippet: Little is known about the connectivity problem for general orthonormal wavelets; partial results exist for MRA wavelets and wavelets with prescribed dimension function.
status_evidence.claim: The connectivity of the full set of orthonormal wavelets in L^2(R) remains an open problem, with only partial results for subclasses.

status_evidence.title: The path-connectivity of MRA wavelets in L^2(R^d)
status_evidence.snippet: Path-connectivity is established for the class of MRA wavelets.
status_evidence.claim: Path-connectivity is known for MRA wavelets but the general orthonormal wavelet case is not resolved.
